choice: One Overpass request for the bounding rectangle of all missing tiles, split back into tiles for the cache; a tile already in flight is awaited instead of requested again
options: One request per call, no tile cache
text: How should OverpassCameraSource fetch the 0.1-degree tiles a bbox is missing?
why: A 50 km trip covers about 30 tiles; one request per tile would hit Overpass's per-IP rate limit and break its fair-use policy
